title: Tekken 5
shortDescription: Definitive fighting installment restoring fast fluid combat, introducing Raven, Feng Wei, and Asuka Kazama.
historicalSignificance: Widely considered the crowning peak of 3D fighting games on PlayStation 2 with pristine arcade balance.
